svg.title: Flywheel offline benchmark record
svg.desc: 6 suites ran with no model endpoint. Accountability: 100% of 8 dimensions, a mean score. Governed agent: 100% of 6 scenarios, 95 percent interval 61 to 100%. Agent recovery: 100% of 6 scenarios, 95 percent interval 61 to 100%. Provider swap: 100% of 10 checks, 95 percent interval 72 to 100%. Source-mined checks: 100% of 26 cases, 95 percent interval 87 to 100%. Flywheel Local Coder 14B against its base model: 3.05 points lower over 164 tasks, a signed difference inside its noise. No peer harness was executed; the 33 peer declaration rows are a dated reading of public documentation.
svg.text: Five suites scored 100 percent on their own tests.
Flywheel Local Coder 14B scored 3.05 points below its base model, within noise.
